annotation.method: manual visual review using 5-second contact sheets plus scene-change timing inspection
annotation.purpose: ground truth for keyframe-selection coverage experiments
annotation.segment_semantics: [start_time, end_time) with inclusive start_frame/end_frame derived at 30 fps
annotation.warning: This is a manually produced research ground-truth subset, not official AIC/BTC ground truth. Medium-confidence boundaries should be human-reviewed before publication-grade evaluation.
